_comment: Shared curated library shelves. Maintained by Matt; add more here at any time (admin-extensible). A 'manual' shelf holds the offers an admin puts on it. A 'smart' shelf is filled automatically from the live facts (e.g. price), so it stays correct as offers re-price. 'category' on a library entry is a free label, so nothing here is a hard limit — this is the working set the tool offers. 'audience' (personal = PCH, business = BCH) shows a shelf only when the Library shows that audience (0.7.13); a shelf without it shows for both, filtered to the audience on show.
